# Complete check of the F-index (all diagrams of the HOMFLY classes)

Knots whose HOMFLY class appears before they are identified (or that are not identified), with tree diagrams up to n = 13. Every diagram of their class, from the lower bound to the index, was compared with the knot (hyperbolic volume, then SnapPy isometry; get_knotinfo / SnapPy census without a hyperbolic structure). 0 diagram chunks crashed SnapPy and count as undecided.
